This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.017 of the raw projection. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1090 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.971 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Gaels attack ×0.995, defense ×1.000 (7 games); Monarchs attack ×1.008, defense ×1.023 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
